title: Reviewed opportunity evidence contract
objective: Define a strict content-addressed comparative opportunity-evidence contract that can prove a positive removable-time lower bound and algorithm disposition for one exact current region without treating hotness as performance causality.

oracles: Recomputed paired comparative statistics and exact region/profile/dashboard bindings
Counterfeit or stale evidence fails closed

handoff.summary: Implemented the standalone sagejs.optimizer-opportunity-evidence/v1 contract, content-addressed composite scope, deterministic ABBA conservative statistics, exact dashboard/workload/compiler/profile joins, warm-sealed baseline requirements, mature-algorithm eligibility gate, preserved losing profiles, and 15 focused adversarial tests. The integration API is createOpportunityEvidence(payload, context, adapter), validateOpportunityEvidence(document, context, adapter), computeOpportunityStatistics(pairs), and opportunityScopeIdentity(payload); the adapter provides validateDashboard, validateWorkload, and validateProfileReceipt only.
risks: Eligible evidence depends on the integration lane landing the shared profile.sampling.protocol validation for warm-prepared-sealed source sampling.
The inherited generated optimizer dashboard is stale on this base, so architecture:check cannot pass until integration regenerates it.
The worktree has no installed FLINT addon; four unrelated compiler fixtures fail while requiring packages/flint/build/Release/sagejs_flint.node.
next_steps: Wire this standalone validator into the integration-owned opportunity adapter without changing its schema or statistics policy.
Construct the production fused-outer-region receipt from the exact hyperelliptic normalization-factor primary and child region IDs.
Regenerate the dashboard and restore the shared native cache before recording the remaining required validation receipts.
